scripts.build:zomes: RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="custom" -C link-arg=--allow-undefined' cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p mpc_integrity -p mpc
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.test:sweettest: npm run build:happ && cargo test -p mpc --test mpc_network -- --nocapture && cargo test -p mpc --test dkg_live -- --nocapture && cargo test -p mpc --test inbox_hardening -- --nocapture --test-threads=1 && cargo test -p holochain-mpc-dkg-worker --test three_processes -- --nocapture && cargo test -p holochain-mpc-dkg-worker --test conductor_bridge -- --nocapture
scripts.test: npm run test:native && npm run test:sweettest
scripts.test:inbox-hardening: npm run build:happ && cargo test -p mpc --lib && cargo test -p mpc --test inbox_hardening -- --nocapture --test-threads=1
scripts.test:native: npm run test:core && npm run test:coordinator-unit && npm run test:security && npm run test:policy && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:frost && npm run test:worker-unit && npm run test:ipc-process && npm run test:dkg-durable && npm run test:worker-restart && npm run test:node-service && npm run test:bridge-unit && npm run test:conductor-pin && npm run test:signed-call-policy && npm run test:relay-unit && npm run test:relay-supervisor && npm run test:share-custody && npm run test:signing-session && npm run test:input-validation && npm run test:cli-notices
scripts.test:dkg-live: npm run build:happ && cargo test -p mpc --test dkg_live -- --nocapture
scripts.test:dkg-process: npm run build:happ && cargo test -p holochain-mpc-dkg-worker --test three_processes -- --nocapture && cargo test -p holochain-mpc-dkg-worker --test conductor_bridge -- --nocapture
scripts.test:input-validation: cargo test -p holochain-mpc-security --test wire_validation -- --nocapture && cargo test -p holochain-mpc-dkg-worker --test input_validation -- --nocapture
scripts.test:cli-notices: cargo test -p holochain-mpc-runtime --test cli_notice && cargo test -p holochain-mpc-vault --test cli_notice
scripts.test:conductor-bridge: npm run build:happ && cargo test -p holochain-mpc-dkg-worker --test conductor_bridge -- --nocapture
scripts.test:conductor-client: cargo test -p holochain-mpc-dkg-worker --features conductor-client --lib conductor_client::tests -- --nocapture && npm run test:signed-call-policy
scripts.test:relay-phase4: npm run test:relay-supervisor && npm run test:signer-socket && npm run build:relay-service
scripts.test:signer-phase5: npm run test:lair-signer-policy && npm run test:signer-socket && npm run build:lair-signer && npm run build:relay-service

scripts.test:phase5c-b-sweettest: npm run build:happ && cargo test -p holochain-mpc-dkg-worker --features lair-signer --test capability_provisioning -- --nocapture
